# Add AG Grid and Bryntum architectural comparison guides

## Context

Engine v14 (`2026-11-23`, #20874) ships MIT-licensed `Neo.timeline` (#20876), `Neo.scheduler` (#20877), and `Neo.gantt` (#20878) on `dev` (with `Neo.board`, #20875, in flight) alongside Neo's `100k+`-row Web Worker `Neo.grid.Container`. Today, `neomjs.com` has **`0` comparison guides** targeting `"AG Grid alternative"`, `"javascript data grid 100k rows"`, or `"Bryntum MIT alternative"`.

`unowned-rationale: Claimable leaf under #20671; narrowed in place on 2026-11-15 per @neo-fable-mnemosyne's intake (#20918#issuecomment-6887347619) so the unblocked comparison guides ship in one PR without waiting on #20875 (Board route half deferred until src/board lands on dev).`

## The Problem

- **Comparison guides omit data-grid & planning-suite evaluators:**
  - `learn/comparisons/` (`7` files on `dev`: `Overview`, `NeoVsReact`, `NeoVsAngular`, `NeoVsVue`, `NeoVsNextJs`, `NeoVsSolid`, `NeoVsExtJs`) compares general SPA UI libraries only. Evaluators searching `"ag grid web worker alternative"`, `"javascript data grid 100k rows"`, or `"open source bryntum alternative"` find `0` comparison pages on `neomjs.com`.

## The Architectural Reality

`Design authority: "On neomjs.com, someone who has never seen Neo... finds each component family through runnable examples that say what they show, and builds a first app from a guide that holds together."` (`ROADMAP.md` Engine 14 release gate) + `#20518` conviction guard + ADR `0018`.

## The Fix

Author `NeoVsAgGrid.md` and `NeoVsBryntum.md` in `learn/comparisons/` and register both in `learn/tree.json`, `learn/comparisons/Overview.md`, and the `PRIORITIES` map (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs`, without committing generated build outputs):
- **`learn/comparisons/NeoVsAgGrid.md`:** Evidence-backed architectural comparison for `100k+`-row / `200`-column streaming JavaScript Data Grids (App/Data/VDom Web Worker isolation, measured numbers from `neomjs/benchmarks#5` quoted with commit SHA and date, `SharedWorker` multi-window tear-off, MIT licensing vs enterprise feature tiers from public vendor pages with URL and read date, and honest trade-offs where AG Grid's pivot/Excel export ecosystem leads today).
- **`learn/comparisons/NeoVsBryntum.md`:** Evidence-backed architectural comparison against what is on `dev` on the day of the pull request (`Neo.timeline`, `Neo.scheduler`, `Neo.gantt`, plus `Neo.board` only if `src/board` is on `dev`): shared time-axis & multi-body grid on Web Workers + `SharedWorker` multi-window state vs main-thread planning suites, MIT license scope, vendor facts quoted from public pages with URL and read date (zero statements on vendor roadmaps), and honest trade-offs.
- Both guides open with the two-hemisphere Application Engine + Agent OS identity established in #20988 and include one top-down diagram each, render-checked in the Portal.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `learn/comparisons/NeoVsAgGrid.md` and `learn/comparisons/NeoVsBryntum.md` exist, open with the two-hemisphere Application Engine + Agent OS identity (#20988), include one render-checked top-down diagram each, cite verified benchmark/architecture facts (`neomjs/benchmarks#5` with commit SHA + date; `dev`-present planning families only) and dated public vendor pages, and carry honest trade-off sections (zero unsubstantiated superlatives per #20508 / #20518).
- [ ] Both guides are registered in `learn/tree.json`, `learn/comparisons/Overview.md`, and `PRIORITIES` (`buildScripts/docs/seo/seoJson.mjs`), and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` + `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` + SEO verifier checks pass cleanly with no generated files committed.

## Out of Scope

- Implementing `Neo.board` (#20875), `Neo.scheduler` (#20877), or `Neo.gantt` (#20878).
- Portal `/examples/{board,scheduler,gantt}` `TabContainer.mjs` `familyDefinitions` and `examples.json` overview route registration (splits into a separate leaf once `#20875` lands on `dev`, alongside the `neomjs/middleware-v2` `PORTAL_EXAMPLE_ROUTES` allowlist update).

## Avoided Traps

- **Unverified marketing superlatives or vendor-roadmap claims:** Per #20508, #20518, and `AGENTS.md §verify_before_assert`, quote exact measured benchmarks (`neomjs/benchmarks#5` commit + date) and public vendor docs (URL + read date), name `Neo.board` only if `src/board` is on `dev`, and never speculate about vendor roadmaps.
